title: Street posters / Tiny Beautiful Things

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Pair a small action with a large title because visual tension can invite a closer look.
strategic_value: The hand, needle and red balloon can give the production a clear visual story within the institutional poster family.
demonstration: A white foreground poster places a hand and needle below a red balloon with tall TINY BEAUTIFUL THINGS lettering between them.
practical_value: Judge how a vertically separated image action works around condensed title type.

content_islands.name: Action and title
content_islands.spec: Position the red balloon at top and reaching hand below, separated by the title.

content_islands.name: Street sequence
content_islands.spec: Keep the Astor season and repeated production panel behind the foreground sign.

reference_purposes.Expression: A white foreground poster places a hand and needle below a red balloon with tall TINY BEAUTIFUL THINGS lettering between them.
reference_purposes.Application: Tiny Beautiful Things is applied to a foreground outdoor sign and repeated on a sign farther along the facade.
